phase: Confirmation of the one effect that resolved. v39 moved the twenty-six citizens with no commute (1 to 7 cells of 208, +0.0288 [+0.0096, +0.0529]) and left the commuters alone (15 to 14). That subgroup was written down as the round's real question before the run. A single round can fail to replicate - v34 did - so this repeats both arms at an independent seed.
primary: Paired per-citizen composition distance against the v18 v25 arm, resampling citizens. Success is a 95% interval that excludes zero on the closer side. The same test on v34 gave -0.0198 [-0.0855, +0.0405], so a difference under about 0.06 cannot be told apart at this roster size.
limitations: Seed 70002 is new; everything else is the v18/v21/v22 cohort and pipeline unchanged.
Both arms are re-run. The v22 comparison reused the v18 v25 arm, so a seed effect could have masqueraded as a prompt effect; here the two arms share the seed.
Twenty-six non-commuters over 208 cells is still small. A failure to replicate does not prove the effect absent, only that this design cannot see it.
